source_refs.note: 2. Agricultural Activities: a main subheading of 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 254-254.

blocks.text: Kheton se behta pani (runoff) fertilizers, pesticides aur herbicides qareeb ke pani mein le jata hai; is tarah kheti pollution mein bara hissa dalti hai. Poor irrigation practices (aabpashi ke ghalat tareeqon) se mitti zyada katti hai (soil erosion) aur mitti (sediments) daryaon aur naalon mein beh jati hai. Bohat se ilaqon mein kheton ki drainage (nikasi ka pani) pollutants le kar zameen ke oopar ke pani (surface water) aur zameen ke neeche ke pani (groundwater) dono ko ganda karta hai.
